text.formatted: The wererat makes two attacks, using Scratch or Hand Crossbow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 11. _Failure:_ The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a **Wererat** under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. _Success:_ The target is immune to this wererat's curse for 24 hours.
